title: Stepper preflight-hold dead-ends on documents step when the blocking file slot was since hidden/cleared — messageEl is invisible
detail: Oversize upload sets data-preflight-blocked; applicant goes Back, ticks never_rented_before or switches employment_status to retired — the slot hides (input cleared, no change event, evaluate never re-runs). The stale block then holds Continue forever, scrolling to an error span inside the hidden slot: no visible feedback, no documented escape.
recommended_fix: Dispatch a change event (or call evaluate()) when the condition engine/employment toggle hides or clears a file input, so data-preflight-blocked and its inline errors clear with the slot; alternatively the hold should ignore messages inside hidden wrappers.

title: {MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR} template used by the too-far-future scenario is undocumented in SKILL.md — runner posts it literally and the scenario silently tests the parse-failure branch
evidence: Scenario: `  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR}"` and its description: "`{MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR}` keeps the pin exactly one month past the 12-month bound forever". But SKILL.md step 4 defines only: `   - {RUN_ID} → the timestamp from preflight / {SHORT_CODE} / {SCENARIO} / {TIMESTAMP} / {MOVE_IN_DATE} → today + 90 days as YYYY-MM-DD`, and line 278 contradicts the scenario: "Only the boundary-validation scenarios (`desired-move-in-date-in-past`, `-too-far-future`) pin literal dates on purpose."
detail: The runner has no substitution rule for {MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR}; the literal string fails date parsing — the parse-failure branch the scenario says is already unit-covered. Both branches yield a desired_move_in_date validation_error, so the scenario still passes while never exercising the 12-month upper bound.
recommended_fix: Document {MOVE_IN_DATE_TOO_FAR} (today + 13 months, YYYY-MM-DD) in SKILL.md's substitution step and template list, and fix the stale line-278 claim that both boundary scenarios pin literal dates.

title: Error-summary anchor click on the current section dispatches rt:form-step-changed with an unchanged step_index
evidence:
File header contract: "F3 seam (save-resume follow-up job): every step CHANGE dispatches `rt:form-step-changed` on document". show(): `if (!opts.initial) dispatchStepChanged(i);`. Anchor handler: `          event.preventDefault();
          show(idx, {});` — idx can equal model.current() (e.g. the error re-render starts at the first error's section and the user clicks that first banner row).
detail: The documented F3 draft-save seam promises events only on step change, but a same-step anchor click emits one anyway. A draft-saver listening per the contract would treat a non-move as a section change.
recommended_fix: In the anchor handler (or show()), skip dispatchStepChanged when idx === model.current(), keeping the change-only contract the header documents.
